description:
The official HD remaster of “Da Ya Think I’m Sexy?” by Rod Stewart, originally released on the 1978 album Blondes Have More Fun. This disco-rock anthem topped charts worldwide and remains one of Rod Stewart’s most iconic songs, blending swagger, humor, and infectious grooves.

With its unforgettable hook, Da Ya Think I’m Sexy? hit #1 in both the U.S. and U.K., solidifying Rod Stewart’s reputation as a global superstar. The HD official video brings new life to the song’s playful energy, making it a must-watch for fans old and new.

The Rod Stewart channel is the official YouTube home for Sir Rod Stewart, the legendary Rock ’n’ Roll Hall of Fame icon with over five decades of chart-topping music. With his unmistakable raspy voice, Rod Stewart has sold more than 200 million records worldwide, earning nine #1 albums, 31 Top 10 singles in the U.K., and 16 Top 10 albums and 26 Top 10 singles in the U.S.

Here you’ll find greatest hits like Maggie May, Tonight’s The Night (Gonna Be Alright), Sailing, I Don’t Want To Talk About It, Stay With Me, Forever Young, The First Cut Is the Deepest, Rhythm of My Heart, and Do Ya Think I’m Sexy?. Enjoy official music videos, legendary live performances including his unforgettable Glastonbury concert, and rare footage from one of the most celebrated careers in music history.
